 - Fixed an issue where the legs would spread apart during front reset. It should now work properly in a sitting position.

 - Simplified the user interface by reducing the onscreen text volume by summarizing explanations for each item into "?" icons.

  - Fixed an issue where the auto power off feature would not activate after 20 minutes when using a dongle and exiting the application.
